content: All deleted forms are moved to '{{sectionName}}'. Restore forms deleted by mistake or delete them permanently. Forms in '{{sectionName}}' are automatically deleted after 30 days. Please note, that forms deleted from '{{sectionName}}' cannot be restored any longer.

comment.text: Informational text on an empty state screen for the forms trash. It explains the restoration, permanent deletion, and 30-day auto-deletion policy, where {{sectionName}} represents the name of the trash section.
